description: Mark an order as fulfilled (delivered); order managers only. Fulfilling transfers reserved stock to the order's target. Three checks answer { requiresAcknowledgment: true, ... } and write nothing; the same call with the named acknowledgment performs it: requested lines that are short (an item line never picked, or a model or category line with fewer picked items than its quantity) come back as `uncovered` (acknowledgeIncomplete: true); picked items that are meanwhile lost/retired come back as `unusableItems` (acknowledgeUnusableItemIds takes their ids); picked items with open issues (status defect or in_repair, an open ticket, or an overdue maintenance check) come back as `itemsWithIssues`, each with its status, the first issue's title and the count (acknowledgeSafetyItemIds). Fails on already-closed orders. Irreversible: a closed order cannot be reopened.

acknowledgeIncomplete.description: true closes the order despite the uncovered lines a previous requiresAcknowledgment result named

acknowledgeSafetyItemIds.description: The ids from a previous result's itemsWithIssues; the items are handed out despite their issues

acknowledgeUnusableItemIds.description: The unusable item ids a previous requiresAcknowledgment result named; the order closes despite them

name: fulfill_order

closedAtIso.description: The same moment as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp — read THIS one; the server does no timezone conversion

instruction.description: Which acknowledge flag performs the call

itemsWithIssues.description: Picked items with open issues: status defect or in_repair, an open ticket, or an overdue maintenance check

count.description: Open tickets plus overdue checks on the item

status.description: defect | in_repair, when the status is one of the two

title.description: The first open ticket's or overdue check's title

requiresAcknowledgment.description: Present and true when nothing was written because of what this result names; the SAME call with the acknowledge flag named in `instruction` performs it

uncovered.description: Requested lines that are short: item lines never picked; model and category lines with `filled` of `required` picked

unusableItems.description: Picked items that are meanwhile lost or retired

status.description: Why it is unusable: lost | retired

webUrl.description: Link to this order in the web app, for a person to open; `orderId` is the handle for tool calls. Absent when the deployment has no public address

title: Fulfill order
